thread:
maya: Hey team — first week q: where are the canonical onboarding doc templates? I want to copy a runbook and a weekly 1:1 template but I don't see the duplicate option in Notion.
devex-bot: Hi Maya! Quick checklist: 1) Are you in the Redwood workspace? 2) Do you have at least 'Can comment' on the template page? If not, request access from the page owner.
maya: I'm definitely in the Redwood workspace. The template pages show up but the 'Duplicate' option is greyed out for me.
alex: Hi Maya — that usually means the template is in a restricted sub-space (we keep some templates view-only to stop accidental edits). Tagging @people-ops and @sasha who own the onboarding bundle.
people-ops: Hey! We own the 'New Hire' kit and the company-level templates. If you need duplication rights for runbooks, we can grant "Can edit" on those specific template pages. Which templates do you need?
maya: Runbook (incident/runbook template) and the "1:1 + goals" template for my manager.
juan: For runbooks we keep a canonical copy in Company Home > Eng > Runbooks > Templates. The duplication workflow is: open the template -> click the ••• menu in the top-right -> select "Duplicate" -> move the duplicated page into your team space. If Duplicate is disabled, PM the page owner or request edit access via the three-dot menu -> "Request access".
maya: I don't see the three dots at all actually on mobile. I'm on desktop now and see them, but duplicate is still disabled.
alex: If duplicate is disabled it might be because the page is a template button or a linked database template — in that case you need to 'Create a new page from template' inside the destination database rather than duplicating. Example: Product > Runbooks database -> New -> choose "Incident runbook (template)".
sasha: @maya I just gave you 'Can edit' on Company Home > Templates > New Hire Kit and the Runbook master. Try refreshing Notion and then Duplicate. If it still doesn't work paste the page URL here and I'll check permissions directly.
maya: Thanks Sasha — refreshed and duplicate is available now. Quick follow-up: where should I move my duplicated runbook? Team space or eng-runbooks?
juan: Good question. Best practice: duplicates for operational runbooks live in eng-runbooks (shared with eng-oncall). Personal templates (notes, 1:1) go in your private workspace or people-ops > 1:1 templates folder and then share with your manager.
people-ops: For 1:1s we prefer people keep a private copy and share a view with their manager (can give 'Can comment' if you want feedback). We also have a starter 1:1 agenda under People Ops > Templates.
maya: Awesome. One last thing — is there a canonical place to file doc ownership so I know who to ping later about edits/updates?
alex: Yes. Each top-level page has an "Owner" property in the page header (hover near the title). We try to keep the owner field populated. If it's empty, ping the channel that owns the area (e.g., eng, product, people-ops) and add a small note on the page with the current owner.
sasha: Also pro tip: add a tiny "doc-meta" block at the top of team docs with sections: Owner, Last updated, How to duplicate. Makes onboarding smoother.
maya: Very helpful — thanks all :raised_hands: I'll move my copies to eng-runbooks and share links once done.
alex: Welcome aboard Maya! If you run into any more Notion quirks ping @devex or drop the page link here.
maya: Will do. Appreciated :)
